records.verificationNote: Read directly from the PA DHS Statewide PDL effective January 2026 v11, 'NSAIDs' section (PDF pages 40-41). Preferred column includes Celecoxib Capsule, Diclofenac Sodium 1% Gel, Diclofenac Sodium 1.5% Topical Solution Drop, Diclofenac Sodium DR/EC Tablet (generic Voltaren EC), Diclofenac Sodium-Misoprostol Tablet, EC-Naproxen Tablet (generic Naprosyn EC), Flurbiprofen Tablet, Ibuprofen (Capsule, Chewable, Suspension, Suspension Drop, 200/400/600/800mg Tablet), Indomethacin Capsule/ER Capsule, Ketorolac Tablet, Meloxicam Tablet, Nabumetone Tablet, Naproxen (250/375/500mg Tablet), Naproxen DR Tablet, Naproxen Sodium (220mg Capsule/Tablet generic Aleve, 275mg Tablet generic Anaprox, DS 550mg Tablet generic Anaprox DS), Piroxicam Capsule, Sulindac Tablet. Non-preferred column includes Arthrotec Tablet, Celebrex Capsule, Diclofenac Epolamine Patch, Diclofenac Potassium (Capsule/Powder Packet/Tablet), Diclofenac Sodium 2% Topical Solution Pump, Diclofenac Sodium ER 24HR (generic Voltaren-XR), Diflunisal Tablet, Dolobid Tablet, Elyxyb Solution, Etodolac (Capsule/Tablet/ER), Fenoprofen Capsule, Fenopron Capsule, Ibuprofen-Famotidine Tablet, Indomethacin Rectal Suppository, Indomethacin Suspension, Ketoprofen Capsule/ER Capsule, Kiprofen Capsule, Lofena Tablet, Meclofenamate Capsule, Mefenamic Acid Capsule, Meloxicam Capsule, Nalfon Capsule/Tablet, Naprelan CR Tablet, Naprosyn Suspension, Naproxen Suspension, Naproxen-Esomeprazole DR Tablet, Naproxen Sodium CR/ER Tablet (generic Naprelan CR), Oxaprozin Tablet, Pennsaid Pump, Relafen DS Tablet, Tolectin Tablet, Tolectin DS Capsule, Tolmetin Sodium (Capsule/Tablet). All statuses read verbatim off two consecutive PDF pages. Naproxen was selected as the representative preferred pick to match the class definition's stated agent order (naproxen, ibuprofen, meloxicam, celecoxib, diclofenac); all five named agents are clean-preferred generics. The PDL does not state a class-specific PA sentence for NSAIDs beyond the document-wide 'non-preferred agents require prior authorization' rule, so the PA determination itself follows that standard convention rather than a quoted class-specific sentence.

records.verificationNote: Read live from the Highmark Comprehensive Formulary search tool (siteCode=8103967260; Formulary Effective Date 07/24/2026). Confirmed Tier 1/no-PA status directly from the 'Analgesic, Anti-Inflammatory or Antipyretic | NSAID Analgesics (COX Non-Specific) - Propionic Acid Derivatives' class listing (42 rows, naproxen/naproxen sodium/ibuprofen/ketoprofen/oxaprozin tablet all Tier 1) and by individually opening the Oxicam Derivatives class (meloxicam 15mg tablet, Tier 1/Low-Cost Generic Rx), the COX-2 Selective Inhibitors class (celecoxib 200mg capsule, Tier 1), and the Acetic Acid Derivatives class (diclofenac sodium DR 50mg tablet, Tier 1). Uncommon strengths/forms of otherwise-Tier-1 generics (e.g. ibuprofen 300mg, naproxen suspension, oxaprozin capsule) and combination/ER/DR products fall to Tier 3 with PA; all named brand products (Naprosyn family, Anaprox DS, Daypro, Nalfon, Orudis) are Tier 3/non-formulary with no PA icon. Confirmed vs inferred: all tiers/PA icons directly read across the four classes checked.
